metadata.title: A shared transcriptional response of Mycobacterium marinum to two microgravity simulators: a re-analysis of NASA OSDR study OSD-528
metadata.description: Processed data, code and manuscript for an independent re-analysis of NASA Open Science Data Repository study OSD-528 (GLDS-528), in which Clary et al. (2022) grew Mycobacterium marinum on a lab-built 3D clinostat, an RPM 2.0 and static 1g and sequenced the bacteria in suspension. All deposited reads were re-quantified (kallisto, paired-end, with rRNA/tRNA decoys), and differential expression (DESeq2), co-expression (WGCNA), GO enrichment, KEGG-mapped metabolic subsystems and leave-one-out classification (TabPFN with baselines) were computed from them. The deposited RFPRPM4 FASTQs contain the RFPRPM41 files followed by a second library; that library is used only in a sensitivity analysis. See DATA_PROVENANCE_DECLARATION.md for how every result is produced and for the repository's history.
